title: Right boundary cell
statement: For a natural-number parameter, a machine configuration on a fixed Boolean input, and a natural-number cell index, define the right neighbor encoding to be the configuration's cell encoding at index one greater than the given index when that index is less than twice the parameter; otherwise it is the blank cell encoding.
caveat: The definition of the configuration's cell encoding is not included in the supplied statement.
